distribution: Edge receives an identical pinned artifact. Consumer parity tests verify both bytes and decisions.
compatibility_definition: A compatible prediction set has at least one regulation-time integer score at which every selection wins. If the only non-losing settlements include a DNB or integer-total refund, the set requires review. Duplicate-selection and portfolio eligibility limits are separate controls.

rules.definition: Home goals greater than, equal to, or less than away goals define 1 X 2.
rules.canonical_definition: Home goals greater than, equal to, or less than away goals define 1 X 2.
rules.calculation_logic: Home goals greater than, equal to, or less than away goals define 1 X 2.
exceptions: DNB and integer goal total equality refunds are explicit; a refund-only compatible set requires review
